subject: Private VPC commercial ask + support options
messages:
From: Samira Jones <samira.j@acmehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@acmehealth.com>, infra@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC — commercial ask + support options

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're evaluating Redwood's private VPC option for a pilot across three hospital sites (approx. 1000 daily inference requests, peak 120 concurrent sessions). Procurement asked for a short commercial summary so they can compare to other incumbent vendors. Key asks from our side:

- Breakdown of the one-time platform fee vs annual recurring licensing.
- Support tiers and included SLOs (response time, on-call coverage, escalation path).
- Any onboarding/implementation credits for pilots and typical delivery timelines.
- Pricing flexibility for a 24-month committed run (we may be able to commit to a minimum GPU-hour anchor).

I've attached our RFP (acme_rfp_v2.pdf) which includes SOC2/KMS/retention requirements. For the next step, Carlos (procurement) would like a short term sheet and a clear statement of what constitutes billable usage for private deploys (seat, node, GPU-hour, tokens?).

Can you get us a concise commercial position by EOD Friday?

Best,
Samira
Director, Data Platform
Acme Health

[attachment: acme_rfp_v2.pdf]

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Samira Jones <samira.j@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@acmehealth.com>, infra@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC — commercial ask + support options

Hi Samira / Carlos,

Appreciate the RFP — this is a helpful level of detail. High level commercial posture for a 24-month private VPC deployment (pilot -> production):

1) Commercial components (recommended structuring)
- One-time Platform Fee: covers private control plane, initial provisioning, and preconfigured observability hooks. Typically amortized over contract length for accounting purposes.
- Recurring License (metered): billing by committed GPU-hours (preferred) or by node/seat for fixed-capacity pilots.
- Support Retainer: tiered (Silver / Gold / Platinum) with differing SLOs and on-call coverage.

2) Typical numbers (ballpark for proposal) — we will finalize after you confirm expected concurrency profile and model choice:
- Platform Fee: $150k one-time (or amortize $6,250/mo over 24 months)
- Committed GPU-hour anchor: volume commit example 20k GPU-hours/month — list price $/GPU-hr to be shown on term sheet
- Support tiers:
  * Silver — business hours ticketing, 24h SLA for severity 1, engineering office hours (no dedicated on-call).
  * Gold — 24x7 on-call for sev1, 4h response during business hours sev2, quarterly operational review.
  * Platinum — 24x7 priority on-call, 1h sev1 response, named SRE for onboarding & runbooks, weekly operational sync.

3) Discount levers we can propose (conditional):
- 12% off list with a 24-month committed GPU-hour anchor and prepay of first 3 months.
- Waive 50% of the platform fee if you commit to a pilot-to-production timeline of <= 3 months and sign by end of Q2.
- Implementation credit: $25k applied to first invoice if you accept our standard SOW within 30 days.

4) Compliance & integration notes (from RFP):
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide SOC2 report and SOC2+redaction guidance.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) — will require network egress rules and a short integration window.
- Audit logs: platform retains token-level audit trails; retention configurable.

Next steps: I attached a 1-page commercial_summary_priya.pdf that lays this out. Can you confirm which of the three support tiers you want priced in the term sheet and whether you prefer GPU-hour or node-based metering for the pilot?

If helpful, I can propose two alternative term sheets by Friday: (A) conservative (lower platform fee, higher metered price); (B) anchored commit (discounts & credits baked in).

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[attachment: commercial_summary_priya.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 May 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Acme pricing posture

Priya — quick internal note before we send options:

- Margin sensitivity: the platform fee waiver is a strong lever but has immediate P&L impact. If we offer a 50% waiver, let's require either a 24-month commit with 6 months prepaid or a 30% up-front implementation prepay.
- Alternate consumer-friendly path: defer 6 months of platform fee (no cap) and offer a $30k implementation credit instead of waiving platform fee. That preserves cashflow for Redwood and still looks attractive to the customer.
- Pricing approval: I can approve up to 12% discount on committed GPU-hours. Anything >12% needs VP signoff (loop in Aditya).

Suggested reply to Acme: provide the two term sheets (Conservative / Anchor) and explicitly call out the conditionality for onboarding credit and platform fee deferment. Ask procurement to indicate preferred support tier and whether they can confirm GPU-hour anchor (or a 3-node pilot).

Marissa
Director, Commercial Strategy

[internal — not to be shared with customer: target discount band 8–12%, preserve option to trade extended payment terms for platform-fee reduction]

From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@acmehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Samira Jones <samira.j@acmehealth.com>, infra@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC — commercial ask + support options

Priya / Marissa — thanks for the detailed options. A few clarifications and our requested changes (attached: redlines_acme_terms.docx):

1) Support tier: we will budget for Gold for initial rollout but need Platinum for 30 days post-go-live. Please include pricing for a temporary Platinum ramp (30 days) that then converts to Gold.
2) Platform fee: procurement prefers the defer-6-months option over a partial waiver. We also want a 15% onboarding credit (prefer applied to month 1–3 invoices).
3) Metering: pilot will be node-based (3 nodes). If production goes to committed GPU-hours, we will convert under the same discount band. Please clarify conversion mechanics and any minimums.
4) Compliance: SOC2 report requested and confirmation of KMS HSM support. Also need a short runbook for key rotation steps.
5) Billable items: please confirm whether minor custom integrations (<40 person-hours) are covered under the implementation credit or billable as professional services.

Attached is our redlined term sheet — high level redlines are: define "billable" vs "non-billable" onboarding, add a 30-day Platinum window, and include a 15% onboarding credit line.

If you can provide an updated term sheet (clean + redlines accepted) and a short pricing appendix that shows: list price, proposed discount, and amortized platform fee scenarios, we'll circulate to Finance and Legal. Target: decision by 2 weeks from today.

Regards,
Carlos Mendez
Head of Procurement — Acme Health
